permitted_claim: Each sample is represented by separate cell-observation and gene-observation point clouds; cells and genes are not treated as independent final biological replicates.
prohibited_claim: Cells or genes are the independent units of a final biological clustering inference.
evidence_artifacts: MV07J claim map; MV8-I topology summary
limitation: Within-sample cells and genes are technical realizations and are deterministically subsampled.

permitted_claim: Landscapes retain finite positive intervals and all active consecutive levels, exclude essential H0 before construction, keep H0/H1 separate, and use exact critical-breakpoint squared-L2 integration here.
prohibited_claim: The accepted method uses a universal fixed grid, k=1, or a universal level cap.
population_or_scope: method contract and eight-unit technical validation
evidence_artifacts: MV8-I landscape execution; MV8-I level summary; landscape contract
limitation: Numerical exactness does not make raw Rips persistence robust to every outlier or filtration choice.

permitted_claim: Cell and gene topology are separate, complementary representations under fixed coordinate, panel, and metric contracts.
prohibited_claim: Cell and gene topology are interchangeable or one is globally superior.
evidence_artifacts: MV07J claim map; MV8-I topology summary
limitation: Cell uses frozen 30-PC Euclidean coordinates; gene uses 475-gene correlation-chord coordinates.

permitted_claim: The common-475 dual-view PH and landscape workflow completed reproducibly across eight independent adult bone-marrow HCA units.
prohibited_claim: The biological conclusions generalize to all tissues, studies, assays, or cell states.

evidence_artifacts: MV8-I independent validation; input identity; repeat ledger
limitation: This is a label-closed technical replication and does not evaluate biological outcomes.

evidence_artifacts: MV8-I topology summary; MV8-I landscape execution

evidence_artifacts: MV8-I repeat ledger; independent validation; public manifest
